query:
UPDATE coupon.store_customers
            SET last_seen_at = $2,
                interaction_count = interaction_count + 1,
                risk_flags = CASE
                    WHEN $3 AND NOT (risk_flags @> '["SELF_TRANSACTION"]'::jsonb)
                        THEN risk_flags || '["SELF_TRANSACTION"]'::jsonb
                    ELSE risk_flags
                END
            WHERE id = $1
